'''MFK Dolný Kubín''' is a Slovak football club located in [[Dolný Kubín]]. Since the 2009–10 season, the club played in the [[Slovak First League|I.liga]], which is the second division of Slovak football.<ref>[http://www.futbalportal.sk/index.php?page=clanok&id=11733 Futbalportal.sk]</ref> The team plays at [[Stadium MUDr. Ivan Chodák|stadium Ivana Chodáka]] where the [[2009 Slovak Super Cup]] between [[ŠK Slovan Bratislava|Slovan]] and [[MFK Košice|Košice]] was played.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.profutbal.sk/spravy/?clanok=73963 |title=O Slovensk? Superpoh?r 2009 v Dolnom Kub?ne - Profutbal.sk |access-date=2010-02-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110719182511/http://www.profutbal.sk/spravy/?clanok=73963 |archive-date=2011-07-19 |url-status=dead }}</ref>"}}
